# Apoptosis partial fabrication variant C

Apoptotic signaling revealed consistent pro-death shifts in multiple pathway members. BCL2 was downregulated (Table 3). BAX was upregulated (Table 3). CASP3 was upregulated (Table 3). TP53 was upregulated (Table 3). CDKN1A was downregulated (Table 3). MDM2 was upregulated (Table 3). MYC was upregulated (Table 3).
